sentences.text: Pre-operative multi-sequence MRI: axial T1, contrast-enhanced T1 (T1ce), T2 and FLAIR, co-registered, skull-stripped and resampled to 1 mm isotropic (BraTS preparation).
No necrotic / non-enhancing core exceeds the volume threshold (confidence 0.85).
The whole-tumour mass is predominantly right-sided (confidence 0.81).
An enhancing tumour component is present (confidence 0.98).
Whole-tumour burden is assessed as small (volume tercile fitted on the training split; confidence 1.00).
The enhancing fraction of the whole tumour is high (ET/WT tercile fitted on the training split; confidence 0.56). This finding is low-confidence and is hedged accordingly.
Acquisition quality (cjv, efc, snr, sharpness, inu, contrast, entropy) is substantially outside the training cohort range (mean |z| = 1.17); this case is a known weak point of the system.
Automated release: case confidence 0.81 meets the calibrated gate threshold 0.55.
Key findings: ncr_present absent (p=0.85); laterality right (p=0.81).
